direction: Establish a robust direct pure-premium baseline on AllState using recipe-based gradient boosting, prioritizing LightGBM Tweedie with native categorical handling. Compare only a small, adaptive set of sensible capacity and regularisation choices; use each cycle's result to decide the next one.
constraints: Use declarative recipes only; do not write custom model scripts.
Stay within direct pure-premium target framing and GBM approach_family.
Prefer LightGBM Tweedie with native categorical encoding; use the handoff's target and feature constraints exactly.
After two consecutive rejected tuning changes, make a structural comparison within the permitted recipe families or stop early with a clear negative learning.
success_criteria: Produce a clean promoted direct-model champion above the global-mean baseline, or determine whether the direct Tweedie recipe line is unpromising and why.
